# Billy Digitals

> Billy Digitals is a premium web design and development agency based in Greater Manchester (Heald Green / Stockport), UK, serving businesses UK-wide and worldwide. Founded by Bilawal Ali, we design, build and grow bespoke, high-performance websites and web apps — conversion-focused design, fast modern development, hosting and SEO, handled end to end by one team.

## What we do
- Custom website design (bespoke, no templates), built to convert visitors into enquiries
- Web development: fast, responsive, modern builds; web apps, booking systems, client portals
- E-commerce websites and online ordering
- SEO and local SEO (Google Business Profile, local landing pages, technical SEO)
- Managed UK hosting with SSL and daily backups, plus ongoing care plans
- Branding, UI/UX and copywriting direction

## Who we help
Small and growing businesses across Greater Manchester and the North West — restaurants and takeaways, salons and barbers, trades, clinics and dentists, gyms, professional firms — and ambitious brands anywhere online.

## Areas served
Stockport, Cheadle, Heald Green, Gatley, Manchester, Manchester City Centre, Altrincham, Wythenshawe, Hulme, Rusholme, Levenshulme, Longsight, Liverpool — and UK-wide / worldwide (fully remote-friendly).
